description.value: Dizzy’s Club / Jazz at Lincoln Center is a jazz club inside the Deutsche Bank Center at Broadway at 60th Street, 5th Floor. The FAQ says there is a food and beverage minimum of $25 per person, per set. Large windows look out over Central Park behind the band. Tripadvisor shows 4.5 Very Good. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “Dizzys Jazz Club is a fantastic beautiful venue, overlooking Central Park”; “The Dizzy Gillespie tribute was wonderful”. Representative watch-outs: “great music, evening spoiled by management”; “Good music, garbage food”.
